## P36.48 — the sources table (manifest row 391, K13 UX9-3)

**Stack:** `r11/P36.48-sources-table` → `r11/P36.47-source-page-a` (never `main`).
**Harness:** devin-desktop/swe-2-high/subagent. **live_verification=false.**

The canonical `/sources/` surface: one `sig.source-row/1` row per registry
entry, three pre-rendered views, asc/desc sort routes, single-dimension
facet routes, the A–Z jump list, the lifecycle partition header, the
anomaly box, `sources.csv`/served `sources.json` + generated Table
Schema, the `/data-freshness/**` 301 map, and the shared row component
the status lane renders (K9 C-12).

### What landed

- **`web/src/lib/sources-table.ts`** — the `TableRow` model: source rows
  + freshness verdicts + execution summaries + registry extras, with every
  absent field a named token (never a guess). Sorts are ordinal maps with
  absences last in both directions; facets are the 12 K9 dims; A–Z index
  computed per view.
- **`web/src/components/SourcesTablePage.astro` / `SourcesTable.astro` /
  `SourceTableRow.astro`** — the page engine, the table shell (view
  switcher, sort links, A–Z nav), and THE shared row component.
- **Routes** — `/sources/` retitled "Sources"; `/sources/runs/` and
  `/sources/rights/` views; `…/sort/<col>/<asc|desc>/` routes for every
  view column; `/sources/by/<dim>/<value>/` facet routes (slugged values);
  `artifact/transparency/sources.csv` + `sources.schema.json` endpoints;
  the `.jsonl` artifact routes now serve at `.json` twins.
- **`/status/sources/`** — renders the same row component over lane data
  (`statusRowToTableRow`), same column set + day-granular "Next run";
  retitled `Source status — runs and freshness`.
- **`/data-freshness/**` 301 map** — all five published URLs route
  through `redirectRules()`'s one generator (K9 C-11, SIG-UI-058); the
  page module is deleted; `stale`/`volatility` land on the runs view.
- **Page types** — `/sources/sort|runs|rights|by/**` classified T1 /
  `sig.source-row/1`; `/status/sources/` gets its own `sig.status-lane/1`
  entry (literal segments outrank `/sources/*/`).
- **`batch-09.md`** — 33 ST-* rows, all `pending` (B-2); supersession
  comments on batch-01 SL-01 + batch-07 SS-09/SS-12/SS-14.
- **Nav / probes / links** — `data-freshness/` removed from nav match +
  release-route probes; HowWeKnowThis, index, methodology, search links
  repointed to `/sources/runs/`; the stale `oklahoma-city` dossier slug
  fixed (`-4064000` suffix).
- **Lighthouse** — `gen-lhci.mjs` emits `/sources/runs/`; regenerated
  `lighthouserc*.json` (the K9 URL coverage).

- `web/tests/unit/sources-table.test.ts` — model + sort + facet +

- `tests/unit/test_p36_48_copy_batch.py` — ST-* rows hash-verify, stay
